final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as specified in their docstrings:

- In export.py, I fixed the to_csv_row function to properly escape item names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In pricing.py, I enhanced parse_price to handle accounting-style negative prices with parentheses and to remove commas before converting to Decimal.
- In pricing.py, I fixed apply_discount to use Decimal arithmetic correctly and to round using the "round half up" rule.
- In report.py, I fixed low_stock to return item names with quantity strictly below the threshold and sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

After these fixes, all tests passed when run with the correct PYTHONPATH.
